mapper.select: SELECT id, title, summary, author_name AS authorName, is_pinned AS isPinned, priority, view_count AS viewCount, created_at AS createdAt FROM announcement WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, priority DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

mapper.update: UPDATE announcement SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, author_name = #{authorName}, is_pinned = #{isPinned}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
